master_action_two_branch.kinetic_sector: selected two-branch P_,X = k sqrt(xi) + 2 xi (k = 16.03, zero free parameters)

canonical_model.note: Unscreened Yukawa proxy (y=1); omits the master-action kinetic screening factor y_tb(g) ~ 7.5e-7 at r ~ 28,000 km.

conclusion: Under the Paper 0 selected two-branch master action (du/dr = y_tb(g) g/c^2), kinetic screening at r = 23,445-32,510 km (y_tb ~ 7.5e-7) suppresses the GSAT-0201/0202 eccentric-orbit clock modulation to delta_eta = 3.93e-17 (alpha = 7.45e-07), passing the Delva et al. (2018) 2-sigma bound (alpha < 5.15e-05) by a factor of 69.1x with zero free parameters (whereas an unscreened y=1 Yukawa profile would require lambda_TEP <= 1299.2 km).
